title: To be continued
logline: Friday. The travelogue ends. TO BE CONTINUED, crossed out, on the last panel. The corner box's promise from June — THE LONG WAY BACK — kept as a joke, which is the only way the strip knows how to keep one.

panels.composition: Gully's. WOOD on the stool with the pad. GULLY. BARNABY. The corkboard: the 61 MI postcard.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, a thin man with a pad on a bait-shop stool talking to a man in an apron, an old dog beneath, a postcard on the corkboard behind

panels.composition: The pad: the last travelogue panel. A caption box: TO BE CONTINUED. A line through it.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, close-up of a drawing pad showing a caption box reading TO BE CONTINUED with a single line struck through it
image.notes: Letter after: TO BE CONTINUED, struck through.

balloons.text: The box said 'The Long Way Back.'
That was it. Sixty-one miles there, sixty-one back. The long way.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, a man in an apron pouring coffee and conceding a point to a thin man on a stool

panels.composition: The dog, under the stool, asleep. Home the whole time. The strip's last caption, in the travelogue face, small: HOME.
panels.caption: HOME.
